WITH qualifying_customers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fullVisitorId
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_201707*`, 
  UNNEST(hits) AS h, UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE p.v2ProductName = 'YouTube Men's Vintage Henley'
  AND h.eCommerceAction.action_type = '6'
)
SELECT p.v2ProductName, SUM(p.productQuantity) AS total_quantity_sold
FROM qualifying_customers qc
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*` g
  ON qc.fullVisitorId = g.fullVisitorId
, UNNEST(g.hits) AS h
, UNNEST(h.product) AS p
WHERE p.v2ProductName != 'YouTube Men's Vintage Henley'
AND p.v2ProductName IS NOT NULL
AND h.eCommerceAction.action_type = '6'
GROUP BY p.v2ProductName
ORDER BY total_quantity_sold DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
  session_month,
  session_type,
  ROUND(AVG(pageviews), 2) AS avg_pageviews
FROM (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    totals.pageviews,
    totals.transactions,
    CASE 
      WHEN totals.transactions >= 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(hits) h, UNNEST(h.product) p WHERE p.productRevenue IS NOT NULL) THEN 'purchase'
      WHEN totals.transactions IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(hits) h, UNNEST(h.product) p WHERE p.productRevenue IS NOT NULL) THEN 'non-purchase'
      ELSE 'other'
    END AS session_type,
    DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date), MONTH) AS session_month
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170401' AND '20170731'
)
WHERE session_type IN ('purchase', 'non-purchase')
GROUP BY session_month, session_type
ORDER BY session_month, session_type

WITH inpatient_costs AS (
  SELECT 
    provider_id,
    provider_name,
    AVG(average_total_payments) AS avg_inpatient_payment
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_2014`
  GROUP BY provider_id, provider_name
),
outpatient_costs AS (
  SELECT 
    provider_id,
    provider_name,
    AVG(average_total_payments) AS avg_outpatient_payment
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.outpatient_charges_2014`
  GROUP BY provider_id, provider_name
)
SELECT 
  i.provider_id,
  i.provider_name,
  ROUND(i.avg_inpatient_payment, 2) AS avg_inpatient_payment,
  ROUND(o.avg_outpatient_payment, 2) AS avg_outpatient_payment,
  ROUND(i.avg_inpatient_payment + o.avg_outpatient_payment, 2) AS combined_avg_cost
FROM inpatient_costs i
JOIN outpatient_costs o ON i.provider_id = o.provider_id
ORDER BY combined_avg_cost DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
  nppes_provider_state as state,
  SUM(total_claim_count) as total_claim_count,
  SUM(total_drug_cost) as total_drug_cost
FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.part_d_prescriber_2014`
WHERE drug_name = 'AMLODIPINE BESYLATE'
GROUP BY nppes_provider_state
ORDER BY total_claim_count DESC
LIMIT 5

WITH RECURSIVE icd10_descendants AS (
  SELECT concept_id_1 AS ancestor_id, concept_id_2 AS descendant_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.concept_relationship`
  WHERE concept_id_1 IN (1569798, 1569765, 1569777, 35208655)
  AND relationship_id = 'Subsumes'
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT d.ancestor_id, cr.concept_id_2
  FROM icd10_descendants d
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.concept_relationship` cr 
    ON d.descendant_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Subsumes'
),
all_icd10_concepts AS (
  SELECT ancestor_id, descendant_id FROM icd10_descendants
  UNION DISTINCT
  SELECT 1569798, 1569798
  UNION DISTINCT
  SELECT 1569765, 1569765
  UNION DISTINCT
  SELECT 1569777, 1569777
  UNION DISTINCT
  SELECT 35208655, 35208655
),
snomed_mappings AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT aic.ancestor_id, cr.concept_id_2 as snomed_concept_id
  FROM all_icd10_concepts aic
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.concept_relationship` cr 
    ON aic.descendant_id = cr.concept_id_1 AND cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
all_snomed_descendants AS (
  SELECT sm.ancestor_id, ca.descendant_concept_id
  FROM snomed_mappings sm
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.concept_ancestor` ca 
    ON sm.snomed_concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
),
standard_concepts AS (
  SELECT 1569798 AS icd10_concept_id, 'L70' AS icd10_code, 'Acne' AS condition_name
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 1569765, 'L20', 'Atopic dermatitis'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 1569777, 'L40', 'Psoriasis'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 35208655, 'L80', 'Vitiligo'
),
participants_per_condition AS (
  SELECT sc.icd10_concept_id, sc.icd10_code, sc.condition_name, COUNT(DISTINCT co.person_id) as participant_count
  FROM standard_concepts sc
  JOIN all_snomed_descendants asd ON sc.icd10_concept_id = asd.ancestor_id
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.condition_occurrence` co 
    ON asd.descendant_concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
  GROUP BY sc.icd10_concept_id, sc.icd10_code, sc.condition_name
),
total AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) as total_participants
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.person`
)
SELECT 
  pc.icd10_code,
  pc.condition_name,
  pc.participant_count,
  t.total_participants,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(pc.participant_count, t.total_participants) * 100 as percentage
FROM participants_per_condition pc
CROSS JOIN total t
ORDER BY pc.icd10_code

WITH all_data AS (
  SELECT year, month, air_temperature, wetbulb_temperature, dewpoint_temperature, sea_surface_temp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2010`
  WHERE sea_surface_temp IS NOT NULL AND air_temperature IS NOT NULL AND wetbulb_temperature IS NOT NULL AND dewpoint_temperature IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT year, month, air_temperature, wetbulb_temperature, dewpoint_temperature, sea_surface_temp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2011`
  WHERE sea_surface_temp IS NOT NULL AND air_temperature IS NOT NULL AND wetbulb_temperature IS NOT NULL AND dewpoint_temperature IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT year, month, air_temperature, wetbulb_temperature, dewpoint_temperature, sea_surface_temp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2012`
  WHERE sea_surface_temp IS NOT NULL AND air_temperature IS NOT NULL AND wetbulb_temperature IS NOT NULL AND dewpoint_temperature IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT year, month, air_temperature, wetbulb_temperature, dewpoint_temperature, sea_surface_temp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2013`
  WHERE sea_surface_temp IS NOT NULL AND air_temperature IS NOT NULL AND wetbulb_temperature IS NOT NULL AND dewpoint_temperature IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT year, month, air_temperature, wetbulb_temperature, dewpoint_temperature, sea_surface_temp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2014`
  WHERE sea_surface_temp IS NOT NULL AND air_temperature IS NOT NULL AND wetbulb_temperature IS NOT NULL AND dewpoint_temperature IS NOT NULL
),
monthly_avgs AS (
  SELECT year, month,
    AVG(air_temperature) as avg_air,
    AVG(wetbulb_temperature) as avg_wetbulb,
    AVG(dewpoint_temperature) as avg_dewpoint,
    AVG(sea_surface_temp) as avg_sst
  FROM all_data
  GROUP BY year, month
)
SELECT year, month,
  ABS(avg_air - avg_wetbulb) + ABS(avg_air - avg_dewpoint) + ABS(avg_air - avg_sst) +
  ABS(avg_wetbulb - avg_dewpoint) + ABS(avg_wetbulb - avg_sst) +
  ABS(avg_dewpoint - avg_sst) as sum_abs_diff
FROM monthly_avgs
ORDER BY sum_abs_diff ASC
LIMIT 3

WITH base_data AS (
  SELECT 
    PARSE_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da)) AS date,
    SAFE_CAST(temp AS FLOAT64) AS temp_f,
    SAFE_CAST(prcp AS FLOAT64) AS prcp_in,
    SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) AS wdsp_knots
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2019`
  WHERE stn = '725290' AND year = '2019' AND mo IN ('01', '02', '03')
),
converted AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    ROUND((temp_f - 32) * 5.0 / 9.0, 1) AS temp_c,
    ROUND(prcp_in * 2.54, 1) AS prcp_cm,
    ROUND(wdsp_knots * 0.514444, 1) AS wind_ms
  FROM base_data
),
with_ma AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    temp_c,
    prcp_cm,
    wind_ms,
    ROUND(AVG(temp_c) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 1) AS temp_ma8,
    ROUND(AVG(prcp_cm) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 1) AS prcp_ma8,
    ROUND(AVG(wind_ms) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 1) AS wind_ma8
  FROM converted
)
SELECT 
  date,
  temp_c,
  prcp_cm,
  wind_ms,
  temp_ma8,
  prcp_ma8,
  wind_ma8,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 1) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS temp_ma_lag1,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 1) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS prcp_ma_lag1,
  ROUND(wind_ma8 - LAG(wind_ma8, 1) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS wind_ma_lag1,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 2) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS temp_ma_lag2,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 2) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS prcp_ma_lag2,
  ROUND(wind_ma8 - LAG(wind_ma8, 2) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS wind_ma_lag2,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 3) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS temp_ma_lag3,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 3) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS prcp_ma_lag3,
  ROUND(wind_ma8 - LAG(wind_ma8, 3) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS wind_ma_lag3,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 4) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS temp_ma_lag4,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 4) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS prcp_ma_lag4,
  ROUND(wind_ma8 - LAG(wind_ma8, 4) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS wind_ma_lag4,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 5) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS temp_ma_lag5,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 5) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS prcp_ma_lag5,
  ROUND(wind_ma8 - LAG(wind_ma8, 5) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS wind_ma_lag5,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 6) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS temp_ma_lag6,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 6) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS prcp_ma_lag6,
  ROUND(wind_ma8 - LAG(wind_ma8, 6) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS wind_ma_lag6,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 7) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS temp_ma_lag7,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 7) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS prcp_ma_lag7,
  ROUND(wind_ma8 - LAG(wind_ma8, 7) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS wind_ma_lag7,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 8) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS temp_ma_lag8,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 8) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS prcp_ma_lag8,
  ROUND(wind_ma8 - LAG(wind_ma8, 8) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS wind_ma_lag8
FROM with_ma
WHERE date >= '2019-01-09'
ORDER BY date
LIMIT 20

SELECT 
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) AS year,
  MAX(CASE WHEN element = 'PRCP' THEN value / 10.0 ELSE NULL END) AS max_precip_mm,
  MIN(CASE WHEN element = 'TMIN' THEN value / 10.0 ELSE NULL END) AS min_temp_c,
  MAX(CASE WHEN element = 'TMAX' THEN value / 10.0 ELSE NULL END) AS max_temp_c
FROM `bigquery-public-data.ghcn_d.ghcnd_*`
WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2013' AND '2016'
  AND id = 'USW00094846'
  AND date >= DATE(CONCAT(_TABLE_SUFFIX, '-12-17'))
  AND date <= DATE(CONCAT(_TABLE_SUFFIX, '-12-31'))
  AND element IN ('PRCP', 'TMIN', 'TMAX')
  AND qflag IS NULL
  AND mflag IS NULL
GROUP BY year
ORDER BY year

WITH alive_1995 AS (
  SELECT 
    UPPER(spc_latin) as species_upper,
    COUNT(*) as count_1995
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_1995`
  WHERE UPPER(status) != 'DEAD'
  GROUP BY UPPER(spc_latin)
),
alive_2015 AS (
  SELECT 
    UPPER(spc_latin) as species_upper,
    COUNT(*) as count_2015
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_2015`
  WHERE UPPER(status) = 'ALIVE'
  GROUP BY UPPER(spc_latin)
),
species_colors AS (
  SELECT 
    UPPER(species_scientific_name) as species_upper,
    fall_color
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_species`
)
SELECT 
  sc.fall_color,
  SUM(COALESCE(a2015.count_2015, 0) - COALESCE(a1995.count_1995, 0)) as total_change
FROM species_colors sc
LEFT JOIN alive_1995 a1995 ON sc.species_upper = a1995.species_upper
LEFT JOIN alive_2015 a2015 ON sc.species_upper = a2015.species_upper
GROUP BY sc.fall_color
ORDER BY sc.fall_color

WITH yellow_trips AS (
  SELECT 
    t.pickup_datetime,
    t.dropoff_datetime,
    t.passenger_count,
    t.trip_distance,
    t.fare_amount,
    t.tip_amount,
    t.tolls_amount,
    t.mta_tax,
    t.total_amount,
    t.extra,
    t.pickup_location_id,
    t.dropoff_location_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.tlc_yellow_trips_2016` t
  WHERE t.pickup_datetime >= '2016-07-01 00:00:00' 
    AND t.dropoff_datetime <= '2016-07-07 23:59:59'
    AND t.passenger_count > 5
    AND t.trip_distance >= 10
    AND t.dropoff_datetime > t.pickup_datetime
    AND COALESCE(t.fare_amount, 0) >= 0
    AND COALESCE(t.tip_amount, 0) >= 0
    AND COALESCE(t.tolls_amount, 0) >= 0
    AND COALESCE(t.mta_tax, 0) >= 0
    AND COALESCE(t.total_amount, 0) >= 0
    AND COALESCE(t.extra, 0) >= 0
),
green_trips AS (
  SELECT 
    t.pickup_datetime,
    t.dropoff_datetime,
    t.passenger_count,
    t.trip_distance,
    t.fare_amount,
    t.tip_amount,
    t.tolls_amount,
    t.mta_tax,
    t.total_amount,
    t.extra,
    t.pickup_location_id,
    t.dropoff_location_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.tlc_green_trips_2016` t
  WHERE t.pickup_datetime >= '2016-07-01 00:00:00' 
    AND t.dropoff_datetime <= '2016-07-07 23:59:59'
    AND t.passenger_count > 5
    AND t.trip_distance >= 10
    AND t.dropoff_datetime > t.pickup_datetime
    AND COALESCE(t.fare_amount, 0) >= 0
    AND COALESCE(t.tip_amount, 0) >= 0
    AND COALESCE(t.tolls_amount, 0) >= 0
    AND COALESCE(t.mta_tax, 0) >= 0
    AND COALESCE(t.total_amount, 0) >= 0
    AND COALESCE(t.extra, 0) >= 0
),
all_trips AS (
  SELECT * FROM yellow_trips
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM green_trips
)
SELECT 
  p.zone_name AS pickup_zone,
  d.zone_name AS dropoff_zone,
  TIMESTAMP_DIFF(t.dropoff_datetime, t.pickup_datetime, SECOND) AS trip_duration_seconds,
  t.trip_distance * 3600.0 / TIMESTAMP_DIFF(t.dropoff_datetime, t.pickup_datetime, SECOND) AS speed_mph,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(t.tip_amount * 100.0, t.total_amount) AS tip_rate_pct
FROM all_trips t
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.taxi_zone_geom` p ON t.pickup_location_id = p.zone_id
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.taxi_zone_geom` d ON t.dropoff_location_id = d.zone_id
ORDER BY t.total_amount DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH confirmed AS (
  SELECT country_or_region, SUM(CAST(_4_20_20 AS INT64)) as total_cases 
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_jhu_csse.confirmed_cases` 
  WHERE country_or_region IN ('US', 'France', 'China', 'Italy', 'Spain', 'Germany', 'Iran') 
  GROUP BY country_or_region
),
population AS (
  SELECT country_name, value as pop_2020 
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_wdi.indicators_data` 
  WHERE LOWER(indicator_name) = 'population, total' AND year = 2020 
  AND country_name IN ('United States', 'France', 'China', 'Italy', 'Spain', 'Germany', 'Iran, Islamic Rep.')
),
mapped AS (
  SELECT 
    CASE WHEN c.country_or_region = 'US' THEN 'United States' ELSE c.country_or_region END as country,
    c.total_cases
  FROM confirmed c
)
SELECT 
  m.country as country,
  m.total_cases as confirmed_cases,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(m.total_cases * 100000, p.pop_2020) as cases_per_100000
FROM mapped m
JOIN population p ON m.country = p.country_name

SELECT 
  s.county_name,
  s.state,
  c.median_age,
  c.total_pop,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(s.confirmed_cases, c.total_pop) * 100000 as cases_per_100k,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(s.deaths, c.total_pop) * 100000 as deaths_per_100k,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(s.deaths, s.confirmed_cases) * 100 as case_fatality_rate
FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2020_5yr` c
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.covid19_usafacts.summary` s
  ON LPAD(CAST(c.geo_id AS STRING), 5, '0') = s.county_fips_code
WHERE s.date = DATE('2020-08-27')
  AND c.total_pop > 50000
  AND s.county_name != 'Statewide Unallocated'
  AND s.confirmed_cases > 0
ORDER BY case_fatality_rate DESC
LIMIT 3

WITH t2015 AS (
  SELECT geo_id, median_income AS median_income_2015
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2015_5yr`
  WHERE geo_id LIKE '06%' AND median_income IS NOT NULL
),
t2018 AS (
  SELECT geo_id, median_income AS median_income_2018
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2018_5yr`
  WHERE geo_id LIKE '06%' AND median_income IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  t2015.geo_id
FROM t2015
JOIN t2018 ON t2015.geo_id = t2018.geo_id
ORDER BY (t2018.median_income_2018 - t2015.median_income_2015) DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH scoring_events AS (
  SELECT 
    game_clock,
    period,
    team_name,
    team_market,
    event_description,
    points_scored,
    elapsed_time_sec,
    event_id,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY elapsed_time_sec, event_id) as rn
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_pbp_sr`
  WHERE game_id = '95cda731-b593-42cd-8573-621a3d1369dc'
    AND points_scored > 0
),
cumulative AS (
  SELECT 
    se.*,
    SAFE_CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN se.team_name = 'Wildcats' THEN se.points_scored ELSE 0 END) 
      OVER (ORDER BY se.elapsed_time_sec, se.event_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS INT64) as wildcats_score,
    SAFE_CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN se.team_name = 'Fighting Irish' THEN se.points_scored ELSE 0 END) 
      OVER (ORDER BY se.elapsed_time_sec, se.event_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS INT64) as fighting_irish_score
  FROM scoring_events se
)
SELECT 
  game_clock,
  wildcats_score,
  fighting_irish_score,
  team_name,
  event_description
FROM cumulative
ORDER BY elapsed_time_sec, event_id

WITH season_max AS (
  SELECT season, MAX(wins) as max_wins
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_historical_teams_seasons`
  WHERE season BETWEEN 1900 AND 2000
    AND market IS NOT NULL
    AND market != ''
  GROUP BY season
),
peak_teams AS (
  SELECT t.market, t.season, t.wins
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_historical_teams_seasons` t
  JOIN season_max s ON t.season = s.season
  WHERE t.season BETWEEN 1900 AND 2000
    AND t.market IS NOT NULL
    AND t.market != ''
    AND t.wins = s.max_wins
),
team_counts AS (
  SELECT market, COUNT(*) as peak_seasons
  FROM peak_teams
  GROUP BY market
)
SELECT market, peak_seasons
FROM team_counts
ORDER BY peak_seasons DESC, market ASC
LIMIT 5

WITH google_hiring AS (
  SELECT
    'Google Overall Hiring' AS category,
    report_year,
    workforce,
    race_asian,
    race_black,
    race_hispanic_latinx,
    race_white,
    gender_us_women,
    gender_us_men,
    NULL AS women_pct
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_dei.dar_non_intersectional_hiring`
  WHERE report_year = 2021 AND workforce = 'overall'
),
google_representation AS (
  SELECT
    'Google Overall Representation' AS category,
    report_year,
    workforce,
    race_asian,
    race_black,
    race_hispanic_latinx,
    race_white,
    gender_us_women,
    gender_us_men,
    NULL AS women_pct
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_dei.dar_non_intersectional_representation`
  WHERE report_year = 2021 AND workforce = 'overall'
),
bls_combined AS (
  SELECT
    'BLS Internet Publishing & Web Search Portals' AS category,
    year AS report_year,
    'internet_publishing' AS workforce,
    percent_asian,
    percent_black_or_african_american AS race_black,
    percent_hispanic_or_latino AS race_hispanic_latinx,
    percent_white,
    NULL AS gender_us_women,
    NULL AS gender_us_men,
    percent_women AS women_pct
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls.cpsaat18`
  WHERE year = 2021 AND subsector = 'Internet publishing and broadcasting and web search portals'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'BLS Computer Systems Design & Related Services' AS category,
    year AS report_year,
    'computer_systems' AS workforce,
    percent_asian,
    percent_black_or_african_american AS race_black,
    percent_hispanic_or_latino AS race_hispanic_latinx,
    percent_white,
    NULL AS gender_us_women,
    NULL AS gender_us_men,
    percent_women AS women_pct
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls.cpsaat18`
  WHERE year = 2021 AND industry_group = 'Computer systems design and related services'
)
SELECT
  category,
  report_year,
  workforce,
  ROUND(COALESCE(race_asian, 0) * 100, 1) AS asian_pct,
  ROUND(COALESCE(race_black, 0) * 100, 1) AS black_pct,
  ROUND(COALESCE(race_hispanic_latinx, 0) * 100, 1) AS hispanic_latinx_pct,

WITH monthly_counts AS (

),
with_lag AS (
  SELECT 
    company,
    trip_month,
    trip_count,
    trip_count - LAG(trip_count) OVER (PARTITION BY company ORDER BY trip_month) AS increase
  FROM monthly_counts
),
max_increases AS (
  SELECT 
    company,
    MAX(increase) AS max_increase
  FROM with_lag
  WHERE increase IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY company
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    w.company,
    w.increase,
    w.trip_month,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY w.increase DESC) AS rn
  FROM with_lag w
  JOIN max_increases m ON w.company = m.company AND w.increase = m.max_increase
)
SELECT company, increase, trip_month
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3

WITH paad_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT bcr_patient_uuid, bcr_patient_barcode
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.pancancer_atlas.Filtered_clinical_PANCAN_patient_with_followup`
  WHERE acronym = 'PAAD'
),
paad_mutations AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ParticipantBarcode, Hugo_Symbol
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.pancancer_atlas.Filtered_MC3_MAF_V5_one_per_tumor_sample`
  WHERE Study = 'PAAD' 
    AND Hugo_Symbol IN ('KRAS', 'TP53')
    AND FILTER = 'PASS'
),
patient_status AS (
  SELECT 
    p.bcr_patient_uuid,
    MAX(CASE WHEN m.Hugo_Symbol = 'KRAS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_kras,
    MAX(CASE WHEN m.Hugo_Symbol = 'TP53' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_tp53
  FROM paad_patients p
  LEFT JOIN paad_mutations m ON p.bcr_patient_barcode = m.ParticipantBarcode
  GROUP BY p.bcr_patient_uuid
),
contingency AS (
  SELECT 
    has_kras,
    has_tp53,
    COUNT(*) as observed
  FROM patient_status
  GROUP BY has_kras, has_tp53
),
margins AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(observed) as grand_total,
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_kras = 1 THEN observed ELSE 0 END) as kras_pos,
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_kras = 0 THEN observed ELSE 0 END) as kras_neg,
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_tp53 = 1 THEN observed ELSE 0 END) as tp53_pos,
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_tp53 = 0 THEN observed ELSE 0 END) as tp53_neg
  FROM contingency
),
chi_calc AS (
  SELECT 
    c.observed,
    m.grand_total,
    m.kras_pos, m.kras_neg, m.tp53_pos, m.tp53_neg,
    CASE 
      WHEN c.has_kras = 1 AND c.has_tp53 = 1 THEN (m.kras_pos * m.tp53_pos) / m.grand_total
      WHEN c.has_kras = 1 AND c.has_tp53 = 0 THEN (m.kras_pos * m.tp53_neg) / m.grand_total
      WHEN c.has_kras = 0 AND c.has_tp53 = 1 THEN (m.kras_neg * m.tp53_pos) / m.grand_total
      ELSE (m.kras_neg * m.tp53_neg) / m.grand_total
    END as expected,
    POWER(c.observed - CASE 
      WHEN c.has_kras = 1 AND c.has_tp53 = 1 THEN (m.kras_pos * m.tp53_pos) / m.grand_total
      WHEN c.has_kras = 1 AND c.has_tp53 = 0 THEN (m.kras_pos * m.tp53_neg) / m.grand_total
      WHEN c.has_kras = 0 AND c.has_tp53 = 1 THEN (m.kras_neg * m.tp53_pos) / m.grand_total
      ELSE (m.kras_neg * m.tp53_neg) / m.grand_total
    END, 2) / 
    CASE 
      WHEN c.has_kras = 1 AND c.has_tp53 = 1 THEN (m.kras_pos * m.tp53_pos) / m.grand_total
      WHEN c.has_kras = 1 AND c.has_tp53 = 0 THEN (m.kras_pos * m.tp53_neg) / m.grand_total
      WHEN c.has_kras = 0 AND c.has_tp53 = 1 THEN (m.kras_neg * m.tp53_pos) / m.grand_total
      ELSE (m.kras_neg * m.tp53_neg) / m.grand_total
    END as chi_sq_component
  FROM contingency c, margins m
)
SELECT 
  SUM(chi_sq_component) as chi_squared_statistic
FROM chi_calc

-- Compute correlation between gain and loss frequencies per cytoband for each chromosome
-- Using RecurrentNumData which already has Morph and Topo filters
-- But RecurrentNumData doesn't have cytoband-level data, only chromosome-level

-- Let me try a different approach: compute correlation between gain and loss frequencies
-- across chromosomes for morph=3111, topo=0401
WITH breast_freq AS (
  SELECT 
    Chromosome,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Abnormality LIKE '+%' THEN CAST(TotalCases AS INT64) ELSE 0 END) as gain_freq,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Abnormality LIKE '-%' THEN CAST(TotalCases AS INT64) ELSE 0 END) as loss_freq
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.RecurrentNumData`
  WHERE Morph = '3111' AND Topo = '0401'
  GROUP BY Chromosome
)
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as n,
  SUM(gain_freq) as sum_gain,
  SUM(loss_freq) as sum_loss,
  SUM(gain_freq * loss_freq) as sum_gl,
  SUM(gain_freq * gain_freq) as sum_gain2,
  SUM(loss_freq * loss_freq) as sum_loss2,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    COUNT(*) * SUM(gain_freq * loss_freq) - SUM(gain_freq) * SUM(loss_freq),
    SQRT((COUNT(*) * SUM(gain_freq * gain_freq) - SUM(gain_freq) * SUM(gain_freq)) * 
         (COUNT(*) * SUM(loss_freq * loss_freq) - SUM(loss_freq) * SUM(loss_freq)))
  ) as pearson_corr_gain_loss
FROM breast_freq
WHERE gain_freq > 0 OR loss_freq > 0

WITH session_params AS (
  SELECT 
    (SELECT MAX(ep.value.int_value) FROM UNNEST(e.event_params) ep WHERE ep.key = 'ga_session_id') AS sess_id,
    (SELECT MAX(ep.value.string_value) FROM UNNEST(e.event_params) ep WHERE ep.key = 'source') AS source,
    (SELECT MAX(ep.value.string_value) FROM UNNEST(e.event_params) ep WHERE ep.key = 'medium') AS medium,
    (SELECT MAX(ep.value.string_value) FROM UNNEST(e.event_params) ep WHERE ep.key = 'campaign') AS campaign
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*` e
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201201' AND '20201231'
    AND (SELECT MAX(ep.value.string_value) FROM UNNEST(e.event_params) ep WHERE ep.key = 'source') IS NOT NULL
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT sess_id, source, medium, campaign,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sess_id ORDER BY 
           CASE WHEN source IN ('<Other>') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
           CASE WHEN medium IN ('<Other>') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         ) AS rn
  FROM session_params
),
best AS (
  SELECT sess_id, source, medium, campaign
  FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1
),
classified AS (
  SELECT 
    sess_id,
    CASE 
      WHEN source = '(direct)' AND medium IN ('(not set)', '(none)') THEN 'Direct'
      WHEN campaign LIKE '%cross-network%' THEN 'Cross-network'
      WHEN (LOWER(source) IN ('alibaba', 'amazon', 'google shopping', 'shopify', 'etsy', 'ebay', 'stripe', 'walmart') 
            OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(campaign), r'^(.*(([^a-df-z]|^)shop|shopping).*)$'))
        AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'^(.*cp.*|ppc|retargeting|paid.*)$') THEN 'Paid Shopping'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('baidu', 'bing', 'duckduckgo', 'ecosia', 'google', 'yahoo', 'yandex')
        AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'^(.*cp.*|ppc|paid.*)$') THEN 'Paid Search'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(source), r'^(badoo|facebook|fb|instagram|linkedin|pinterest|tiktok|twitter|whatsapp)$')
        AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'^(.*cp.*|ppc|retargeting|paid.*)$') THEN 'Paid Social'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('dailymotion', 'disneyplus', 'netflix', 'youtube', 'vimeo', 'twitch')
        AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'^(.*cp.*|ppc|retargeting|paid.*)$') THEN 'Paid Video'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) IN ('display', 'banner', 'expandable', 'interstitial', 'cpm') THEN 'Display'
      WHEN (LOWER(source) IN ('alibaba', 'amazon', 'google shopping', 'shopify', 'etsy', 'ebay', 'stripe', 'walmart') 
            OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(campaign), r'^(.*(([^a-df-z]|^)shop|shopping).*)$'))
        AND NOT REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'^(.*cp.*|ppc|retargeting|paid.*)$') THEN 'Organic Shopping'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(source), r'^(badoo|facebook|fb|instagram|linkedin|pinterest|tiktok|twitter|whatsapp)$')
        OR LOWER(medium) IN ('social', 'social-network', 'social-media', 'sm', 'social network', 'social media') THEN 'Organic Social'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('dailymotion', 'disneyplus', 'netflix', 'youtube', 'vimeo', 'twitch')
        OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'.*video.*') THEN 'Organic Video'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('baidu', 'bing', 'duckduckgo', 'ecosia', 'google', 'yahoo', 'yandex')
        OR LOWER(medium) = 'organic' THEN 'Organic Search'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'referral' THEN 'Referral'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('email', 'e-mail', 'e_mail', 'e mail') OR LOWER(medium) IN ('email', 'e-mail', 'e_mail', 'e mail') THEN 'Email'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'affiliate' THEN 'Affiliates'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'audio' THEN 'Audio'
      WHEN source = 'sms' OR LOWER(medium) = 'sms' THEN 'SMS'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'.*push$') OR LOWER(medium) LIKE '%mobile%' OR LOWER(medium) LIKE '%notification%' THEN 'Mobile Push Notifications'
      ELSE 'Unassigned'
    END AS traffic_channel
  FROM best
)
SELECT traffic_channel, COUNT(DISTINCT sess_id) AS total_sessions
FROM classified
GROUP BY traffic_channel
ORDER BY total_sessions DESC

-- Final retention query: 14-day retention (users who had any event 14+ days after initial quickplay)
-- Cohort: users with session_start in July 2-16 who also had a quickplay event in July 2-16
-- Initial quickplay: first quickplay event (by timestamp) in July 2-16
-- Retention: user had any event 14+ days after their initial quickplay event
WITH session_users AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180702' AND '20180716'
    AND event_name = 'session_start'
),
user_first_qp AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    event_timestamp as first_qp_ts,
    event_date as first_qp_date,
    event_name as first_qp_event,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_pseudo_id ORDER BY event_timestamp) as rn
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180702' AND '20180716'
    AND event_name LIKE '%quickplay%'
),
user_initial_qp AS (
  SELECT user_pseudo_id, first_qp_ts, first_qp_date, first_qp_event
  FROM user_first_qp
  WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT 
  uqp.first_qp_event,
  COUNT(DISTINCT uqp.user_pseudo_id) as cohort_size,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.user_pseudo_id IS NOT NULL THEN uqp.user_pseudo_id END) as retained_count,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.user_pseudo_id IS NOT NULL THEN uqp.user_pseudo_id END),
    COUNT(DISTINCT uqp.user_pseudo_id)
  ) as retention_rate
FROM user_initial_qp uqp
INNER JOIN session_users su ON uqp.user_pseudo_id = su.user_pseudo_id
LEFT JOIN `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*` e 
  ON e.user_pseudo_id = uqp.user_pseudo_id
  AND e.event_timestamp >= uqp.first_qp_ts + 14 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000000  -- 14 days in microseconds
  AND e._TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180716' AND '20181003'
GROUP BY uqp.first_qp_event
ORDER BY cohort_size DESC
